description: In-place 1.20.0 -> 1.21.0 change: kdef.tile-blit evidence locator/claim/limits and the 13 wnd# window.tile-blit rationales. Statuses, cases and requirements unchanged.

priorEvidence.locator: | TILE | `0x0feae` | `feae(dirByte, srcRect*, dstRect*)` (`fp@8/12/16`) | step dst by src cell size, CopyBits/CopyMask one tile, clamp last partial. `dir` = horizontal vs vertical run (`(pc==11\|\|pc==14)?0:1`). 1px-tall and 1px-wide fast paths. **Always tiles; never scales.** |
priorEvidence.claim: Non-18 cells tile the source cell across the destination, clipping the final tile.
priorEvidence.limits: The direction byte (pc==11||pc==14)?0:1 is recorded but its absolute/side-relative meaning and 1-D vs 2-D stepping are not decoded. CopyMask interaction with earlier sides, device colour and code-18 scaling are not established.
